caption: A vibrant, spicy ramen broth glows beneath a generous mound of shredded cabbage and chopped green onions. Served in a white ceramic bowl, the dish rests on a dark tray under warm, inviting light.

segments_info.text: Dark brown tray with smooth, slightly reflective surface, rectangular shape with rounded corners visible.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with a slightly glistening surface and irregular, soft edges.
The spicy broth is reddish-orange, glossy, and speckled with sesame seeds, swirling around noodles and toppings.
White ceramic bowl with smooth, speckled surface, slightly raised rim, and faint orange residue along inner edge.
